title: Mining the Design Space of Multi-Agent Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.31709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Designing large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems (MAS) still relies on trial and error and informal "folk wisdom." Manual studies test only a few communication structures or topologies (e.g., sequential, parallel, shared-memory, or debate), while automated optimizers discard search trajectories after selecting a task-specific workflow. We present a two-phase pipeline for mining reproducible design principles from workflow code and execution traces. We repurpose AFlow's MCTS optimizer across six composable operators and 26 deterministically verified Enigmata tasks, retaining all intermediate rounds to build a corpus of 28,568 executable workflows. A sandboxed AutoResearch loop then mines orchestration code and prompt templates under an $L_0$-penalized validation objective and tests candidate principles on held-out searches. Across 300 feature-mining trials, we identify effects that persist on held-out searches across three level

translated_title: 挖掘多智能体工作流的设计空间
translated_abstract: 设计基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）目前仍依赖于反复试错和非正式的“民间智慧”。人工研究仅测试少数几种通信结构或拓扑（例如串行、并行、共享内存或辩论），而自动化优化器在选定特定任务的工作流后便丢弃搜索轨迹。我们提出了一个两阶段流水线，用于从工作流代码和执行轨迹中挖掘可复现的设计原则。我们将AFlow的MCTS优化器重新应用于六种可组合算子和26个经过确定性验证的Enigmata任务，保留所有中间轮次，从而构建了一个包含28,568个可执行工作流的语料库。随后，一个沙盒化的AutoResearch循环在L0惩罚验证目标下挖掘编排代码和提示模板，并在留出的搜索任务上测试候选设计原则。在300次特征挖掘试验中，我们识别出了在三个层级的留出搜索上持续存在的效应。
tldr: 提出一个两阶段流水线，通过挖掘28,568个可执行工作流的代码与执行轨迹，自动提炼出可复现的多智能体系统设计原则。
en_tdlr: Proposes a two-phase pipeline that mines 28,568 executable workflows' code and execution traces to automatically extract reproducible design principles for LLM multi-agent systems.
